integrity: Two independent exhaustive enumeration implementations, the complete normalized census, and an exact order-preserving alphabet-lifting proof are provided. External independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: Exact enumeration concerns only six-letter primitive necklaces and linearly unclustered BWT outputs over an ordered alphabet; it does not classify other lengths. Historical priority is subject to unindexed sources.
title: Exact input-run spectrum of completely unclustered six-letter Burrows–Wheeler images
